phase1.assumption: Traditional evidence-based research systems are the most reliable and efficient for generating valid conclusions.
phase1.inversion: Alternative, non-traditional evidence-grounded systems (e.g., participatory, AI-driven, or decentralized models) are more reliable and efficient for generating valid conclusions.
predictions: Alternative systems will demonstrate 20% higher replication success rates in peer-reviewed studies compared to traditional methods.
Research outputs from inverted systems will show 30% greater transparency in data sharing and methodology disclosure.
Adoption of inverted systems will reduce time-to-adaptation to new evidence by 40% in high-impact fields like medicine or climate science.
